title: A Portrait for the Hymn
author: Xanthe Brightwater
blurb: Xanthe Kavanagh, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
